dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Sharp! That's the best out of all my legendary stories.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: On the other side of this continent, there's a barren domain where nothing grows.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: A sea of ashes, with nothing but silence that will make your ears ring...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: ...And the monster created a vortex in the Mare Jivari, so I held tightly onto my friend's hand...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: ...Sadly, I was the only one who returned home to Mondstadt with tears in my eyes...
